subtitle: Out Manila · Cathay Pacific
overview: Fly via Hong Kong to Haikou and travel south through Lingshui and Sanya to Ocean Flower Island, staying in 5-star hotels. Highlights include Haikou Qilou Old Street, Boundary Island, Phoenix Ridge Mountain Top Park, Yalong Bay Rose Valley and the Ocean Flower Island parade. Philippine passport holders enjoy 30-day visa-free entry to Hainan.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 3–8 2026 to Mar 25–30 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Hong Kong – Haikou
items: Fly Manila to Hong Kong (CX912 08:00–10:30), then to Haikou (CX310 14:10–15:40)
Meet the English-speaking guide at Haikou airport
Haikou Qilou Old Street, century-old Qilou buildings

itinerary.title: Haikou – Lingshui
items: Lingshui Boundary Island (round-trip ferry included, marine tours not included)

itinerary.title: Lingshui – Sanya
items: Sanya Phoenix Ridge Mountain Top Park (round-trip cable car included)
Luhuitou Mountain Top Park (electric cart included)
Optional: Yacht night tour on Sanya Bay

itinerary.title: Sanya
items: Binglang Valley Li and Miao Cultural Tourism Area (electric cart included)
Yalong Bay Rose Valley (electric cart included)
Optional: Binglang Valley Ancient Charm Show + hotel seafood buffet

itinerary.title: Sanya – Haikou
items: Riyue Bay, a world-class surfing base
Ocean Flower Island parade, wedding chapel light show and strolling the eight themed streets

itinerary.title: Haikou – Hong Kong – Manila
items: Lunch, then transfer to airport and fly to Hong Kong (CX313 16:45–18:15) and on to Manila (CX939 22:10–00:20+1)

placeDesc.Haikou Qilou Old Street: A historic street of century-old arcaded Qilou buildings in Haikou showing Southeast Asian influence.
placeDesc.Dongpo Old Wharf: A Haikou heritage site where the tour introduces local intangible cultural heritage.
placeDesc.Hainan Provincial Museum: The main museum of Hainan Island, covering its history and culture.
placeDesc.Boundary Island: An island off Lingshui reached by round-trip ferry; marine tours are not included.
placeDesc.Phoenix Ridge Mountain Top Park: A hilltop park above Sanya reached by round-trip cable car, with views over the city.
placeDesc.Luhuitou Mountain Top Park: A hilltop park above Sanya Bay, visited by electric cart.
placeDesc.Dadonghai: A popular beach and tourist area in Sanya.
placeDesc.Binglang Valley: The Li and Miao cultural tourism area in Sanya, explored by electric cart.
placeDesc.Yalong Bay Rose Valley: A flower-themed park near Yalong Bay, visited by electric cart.
placeDesc.Riyue Bay: A coastal bay in Wanning known as a world-class surfing base.
placeDesc.Ocean Flower Island: A resort island at Danzhou with a parade, wedding chapel light show and eight themed streets.
placeDesc.Danzhou Salt Fields: Ancient salt fields in Danzhou where sea salt is made by traditional methods.
placeDesc.Yangpu Port: A port area in Danzhou, seen on a drive tour on the last day.
